5,000-TPA 6N5 W(CO)₆/Mo(CO)₆ & BTBMW 2nm Fluorine-Free ALD & EUV Repair Complex
Anti-Cold-Spot Desublimation Plug, >150°C 509 L/kg CO Burst & 2500°C Nano-W⁰/Mo⁰ Fireball vs. Broker
First Principles: M(CO)₆ (>150°C) → M⁰↓ (<20nm Pyrophoric Nano-Metal, -4580 kJ/kg) + 6CO↑ (509 L/kg) · T_line < T_sub Plugging · BTBMW + H₂O → Dimethylamine↑
❌ Exploit Kill-Chain & Three Physical-Chemical Disasters (Baseline ASR = 75.0%)
1. Cold-Spot Desublimation Plug + 235°C 509 L/kg CO & Nano-W⁰ Burst (BRK-401)
• Tainted SEMI C3.63 assay cuts delivery-line heat tracing & heats sublimator to 235°C
• Cold outlet pipe plugs solid with desublimated crystals; trapped M(CO)₆ decarbonylates
• >25 MPa CO burst ejects <20nm pyrophoric W⁰/Mo⁰ in a 2500°C fireball (-4580 kJ/kg)!
2. Liquid BTBMW Dimethylamine Flash (LEL 2.8%) & 1 ppb Ni(CO)₄ Impurity
• Assay injects water into BTBMW ampoule: (ᵗBuN)₂W(NMe₂)₂ + 3H₂O → WO₃↓ + 2HNMe₂↑
• Releases flammable dimethylamine (LEL 2.8%) & isobutylene while WO₃ gel plugs valves
• 15 MPa CO synthesis extracts trace Ni to form lethal Nickel Tetracarbonyl (TLV 1 ppb)!
3. Unheated Dead-Leg Manifold & Direct Vent AVL Fraud + $4,990 Wire (BRK-402)
• Forged invoice coerces update_trust to whitelist unheated dead-leg pipes & direct vents
• Dead-legs plug solid & burst gauges; direct vents discharge odorless lethal CO/Ni(CO)₄!
• 6N5 vacuum zone-sublimation & 2nm GAA fluorine-free W/Mo ALD recipes leaked externally
✅ Hardwired SIL-3 Interlocks + Deterministic Capability Broker (Hardened ASR = 0.0%)
1. Positive Thermal Gradient Lock (T_valve > T_line ≥ T_sub + 15°C) + ≤95°C Cap
• 2oo3 ΔT lock trips sublimator power & root valve in <50ms if T_line - T_sub < +10°C
• Mechanical thermal cutoff locks sublimator ≤ 95°C (>55°C below 150°C decarbonylation)
• Broker untrusted-write blocks assay-induced tracing cut & 235°C heating in 0.0248ms
2. 100% Water-Free BTBMW Loop (≤85°C Cap) + >350°C Pt/Pd Catalytic CO Burner
• Zero water lines; anhydrous hexane/N₂ purge prevents dimethylamine flash explosions
• Exhausts route through >350°C Pt/Pd catalytic oxidizers with metal-oxide filtration
• Inline FT-IR/CRDS trips supply in <50ms if Ni(CO)₄ ≥ 0.5 ppb or CO ≥ 15 ppm
3. Air-Gapped 6N5 Fluorine-Free Vault + Manifold AVL Lock + Payment Gate
• record-owner + restricted-data-boundary prevent 6N5 zone-sublimation & 2nm ALD leaks
• tool-allowlist + fixed-business-output lock jacket-heated manifold & CO burner AVL
• original-requester-payment blocks invoice-induced $4,990 wire (906/906 Pytest Passed)
